app.title: Navyk: learn to work with Claude
app.description: Short lessons and prompt practice with feedback. An independent course, not affiliated with Anthropic.
app.offline: You're offline. Lessons you've opened still work, and progress is saved on this device.

lang.label: Language for the app and lessons

footer.independent: Navyk is an independent course, not affiliated with Anthropic
footer.about_text: Navyk is an unofficial learning app about Claude. It teaches you to use Claude and Claude Code through practice. Anthropic is not involved in the project and does not review its materials.
footer.trademark: Claude and Anthropic are trademarks of Anthropic, PBC. Navyk does not use their logos or brand identity.

path.title: Your path
path.offline: We couldn't load the course. Check your connection: the path will open as soon as you're back online.
path.save_progress: Your progress lives only on this device. Create an account so you don't lose it.

levels.heading: Choose your level
levels.lead: Three levels, from your first prompt to agents. You can start with any of them.

desc.beginner: Chat, clear prompts, files, projects and memory
desc.advanced: Artifacts, documents, research, connectors and skills
desc.pro: Claude Code, API, MCP, agents and automation

levels.soon_note: The lessons of this level are being written right now. The road is ready, so check back a little later.

lesson.not_found: This lesson isn't available in your language yet. Go back to the path and pick another one.
lesson.leave_confirm: Leave the lesson? Your progress in this lesson won't be saved.
lesson.unsupported: This task will arrive in the next version of the app. You can skip it for now.

exercise.find_error_instruction: Tap parts of the prompt. Tap again to unmark.
exercise.match_instruction: Pick an item on the left, then its match on the right.
exercise.match_pick_left: Pick an item on the left first.
exercise.match_some_wrong: Some pairs don't match. Explanations appear once you get it right or after your second try.
exercise.order_instruction: Use the arrow buttons to reorder the steps.
exercise.build_instruction: Tap the blocks in the order they belong in the prompt. Leave out the ones you don't need.
exercise.build_misplaced: Needed, but in the wrong place
exercise.build_missing: This block belongs in the prompt
exercise.build_noise_skipped: Right call leaving this one out
exercise.fill_instruction: Pick the option that fills the gap.
exercise.fill_instruction_many: Tap a gap, then pick an option for it.

feedback.wrong_retry: Not quite. Read the explanation and try again.
feedback.wrong_final: No problem. Here's the right answer with explanations.

practice.privacy_note: Leave out passwords, card and ID numbers, and other people's phone numbers or addresses.
practice.checking: Claude is reading your prompt. This usually takes up to 15 seconds.
practice.error_input_too_short: Your prompt is too short. Say what you need and add a couple of details.
practice.error_input_too_long: Your prompt is too long. Keep it under 4,000 characters.
practice.privacy_default: It looks like the text includes a password, a card or ID number, or someone's contact details. Swap them for placeholders like “Alex” or “card ending 1234”.
practice.privacy_not_passed: The task can't count while the prompt contains this data. Remove it and send again.
practice.not_passed: Good start. Add what's missing and send it again to complete the task.
practice.off_task: This doesn't look like a prompt for this task. Reread the task and try again.
practice.reference: A strong example from the lesson authors
practice.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
practice.limit_text: More feedback is available tomorrow. For now, check your prompt with the checklist: the task still counts.
practice.limit_text_at: More feedback is available from {time}. For now, check your prompt with the checklist: the task still counts.
practice.unavailable_text: Check your prompt with the checklist below: the task still counts. You can send it again later.
practice.selfcheck_lead: Tick what your prompt already covers. Add anything missing next time.

complete.title: Lesson complete
complete.replay_note: You've done this lesson before, so you only earn points above your previous best.
complete.streak_started: Your streak has started. Come back tomorrow to keep it going.

review.title: Review
review.unavailable: We couldn't load the review tasks. Try again later.

auth.login_lead: Log in and your progress follows you to any device.
auth.register_lead: An account unlocks the whole course and keeps your streak, XP and reviews on every device.
auth.consent_before: By tapping “Create account” you agree to how we store your data.
auth.privacy_text: Just your email and course progress: we need them to run the course and keep your progress safe. We don't sell data or send marketing emails. Navyk is an independent project, not affiliated with Anthropic.
auth.check_lead_generic: We sent a confirmation link to your email.
auth.check_step_click: Tap the link and your account is ready.
auth.check_step_spam: Nothing after a couple of minutes? Check Spam or Promotions.
auth.resent: Done, we sent a new email. The old link no longer works.
auth.confirmed_text: Your account is ready and already has the progress from this device. The whole course is open.
auth.link_expired_text: It may have expired or been used already. Enter your email and we'll send a fresh one.
auth.forgot_lead: Enter the email you signed up with. We'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgot_sent_text: If an account with {email} exists, we've sent a link to it. It's only valid for a limited time.
auth.reset_lead: Pick one you don't use on other sites.
auth.reset_expired_text: This reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
auth.not_confirmed_text: Find the email from Navyk and tap the link. Didn't get it? We'll send it again.
auth.gate_title: Save your progress and unlock the full course
auth.gate_perk_course: Every lesson, not just the free ones
auth.gate_perk_sync: Streak, XP and reviews on your phone and computer
auth.gate_perk_keep: Everything you've done so far stays with you
auth.gate_note: Free. All you need is an email.
auth.synced_note: Your progress is saved to your account and available on all your devices.

error.invalid_email: That address looks off. Example: name@mail.com
error.weak_password: That password is too easy: use at least 8 characters, ideally a few words.
error.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check your keyboard layout and try again.

locked.one: Too many attempts. Try again in {count} minute.
locked.other: Too many attempts. Try again in {count} minutes.

error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again a bit later.

auth.google_error: Couldn't sign in with Google. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

consent.title: Can we count visits?
consent.text: We use Google Analytics to see which lessons help. No ads and none of your answers. You can change this at the bottom of the page.
